explanation: This slide covers mortality patterns and survivorship. A cohort is defined as all the members of a population born at the exact same time. Life tables are statistical tables showing how many members of a given cohort remain alive after specific time intervals. Survivorship is defined as the probability that newborn individuals of a cohort will survive to reach a particular age. Survivorship curves are graphical plots representing the number of surviving organisms at each age over their lifespan.
